gpio_path.description: GPIO system pin path. RPi/odroid/nanopi/pine64 = /sys/class/gpio, orangpi = /sys/class/gpio_sw

gpio_in_high.description: Space separated list of GPIO pins that point IN and have an Active HIGH state (3.3v = ON, 0v = OFF)

gpio_in_low.description: Space separated list of GPIO pins that point IN and have an Active LOW state (0v = ON, 3.3v = OFF)

gpio_out_high.description: Space separated list of GPIO pins that point OUT and have an Active HIGH state (3.3v = ON, 0v = OFF)

gpio_out_low.description: Space separated list of GPIO pins that point OUT and have an Active LOW state (0v = ON, 3.3v = OFF)

gpio_user.description: User that should own the GPIO device files

gpio_group.description: Group for the GPIO device files

gpio_mode.description: File access mode for the GPIO device files
